Annotate any PDF

Open a PDF, then write on it with the pen, highlight key lines, drop in text boxes, shapes and arrows, and zoom in for detail. Save it to the cloud and pick up exactly where you left off — or download a copy with everything stamped onto the PDF itself.

AI Engine

Choose which AI powers every AI feature on this worksheet — Answer and Improve on text boxes, the Answer key, AI notes, marking, keyword extraction and Ask AI. The app starts on ChatGPT gpt-5.6-sol; paste your key below once and it is used everywhere. Gemini needs no key and is what runs until a key is saved — and whenever ChatGPT fails, the app falls back to it by itself, so the AI never simply stops working.
Used only by the picture AI note card (the chat model above cannot draw). If ChatGPT image generation fails, the app falls back to the Gemini image model, then to a drawn SVG.
Paste it once. It is kept in this browser and in your own teacher-only settings record, so every device you sign in with — a new iPad, a cleared browser, a reinstall — picks it up again by itself and never asks for it twice. Only your admin account can read it; students and share-link visitors cannot, and they simply keep using Gemini. Clear the box and save to forget it everywhere.
Moonshot renames its flagship with every release, so this is a box, not a fixed list: 🔄 Load models asks your own Kimi account which ids it will answer to. If Kimi starts refusing every call, an out-of-date id here is the first thing to check — the error names the model it tried.
Paste it once. Like the OpenAI key it is kept in this browser and in your own teacher-only settings record, so every device you sign in with picks it up again by itself. Only your admin account can read it. Clear the box and save to forget it everywhere.

Teaching notes

Everything the AI writes on this worksheet — answers, the answer key, explanations, note cards and every mark it gives a student — is written from what is on this page: your notes, and the answers you have already written on your own worksheets. Nothing here is shown to students.

Add a note

Type it and it is in. This goes straight into your general guidance — the standing instructions the AI reads on every worksheet, whether it is writing an answer, building an answer key, explaining something or marking a student. No file, no waiting, nothing shown to students.

Edit these notes

Fine-tune what the AI pulled out — above all the keywords, which it looks for when marking and reaches for when it writes.
